_comment: 728-E/F Package 1 read-back for Cloudflare MCP portal `writer` (account D3LS). Non-secret build input: no token values. Source: loop-architecture 728ef-build.md section 2 + 728ef-writer2.out (portal GET + token-authenticated tools/list, 2026-11-13). amendment_2026_11_17: 728-EF §5 item 2 contract amendment (G1): the five write names above were absent from this artifact; they are recorded as verified_disabled_* — present in the live catalogs but NOT enabled on the portal — so enabled_catalog/enabled_served (the validator's D8-1 source, == the construction-phase enabled set) are intentionally unchanged. A future W1/W3 flip PR moves a name from verified_disabled_* into enabled_* together with its Cloudflare portal flip.
